name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu 下拉菜单
description: 点击按钮后展开的操作列表。

whenToUse: 收纳一组相关操作，如“更多”菜单
accessibility: 方向键在菜单项间移动，Esc 关闭
危险操作项使用 destructive 样式
responsive: 窄屏下菜单保持在视口内

files.content:
# Dropdown Menu 设计规范

- 用于点击按钮后展开的一组操作命令；为表单选值用 Select，右键菜单用 Context Menu，站点导航用 Navigation Menu。
- 打开菜单的按钮通过 `DropdownMenu.Trigger` 的 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 渲染 Button；只有图标的触发按钮要有 `aria-label`（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`、`valar/icon-button-label`）。
- 操作用 `DropdownMenu.Item` 的 `onSelect`；跳转页面用 `child` snippet 把 `props` 传给 `<a href>`，不要在 Item 里再嵌套链接或按钮。
- 删除等不可撤销的操作放在末尾，用 `DropdownMenu.Separator` 分组。普通菜单项打开 Alert Dialog，危险色用于最终确认。需要直接强调菜单命令时可以使用 `variant="destructive"`。
- 可勾选的设置用 `DropdownMenu.CheckboxItem`，多选一用 `DropdownMenu.RadioGroup` 与 `DropdownMenu.RadioItem`。行尾符号表达已选或半选状态，行底色随鼠标和键盘焦点移动。选择后默认保持打开，可按流程设置 `closeOnSelect`。
- 分组标题用 `DropdownMenu.Label`（或 Group 里的 `GroupHeading`），没有图标的项需要与有图标的项对齐时设 `inset`。
- `DropdownMenu.Shortcut` 只显示快捷键文字，不会绑定按键；显示的快捷键必须在别处真正实现。
- 菜单宽度默认与触发按钮一致；需要更宽时用 `min-w-*` 档位，位置用 `align`、`side` 属性，不要写像素值。
- 主菜单和子菜单默认采用 12 px 圆角的实色面板与 0.5 px 描边。操作行和 Context Menu 一致，最小高度 32 px、圆角 8 px、图文间距 8 px，行内起止留白为 8／12 px。单选和复选给勾选符号预留 32 px，分隔区高 12 px。文字为 13 px／400。`appearance="surface"` 按内容定宽。主菜单和子菜单应使用同一个主题 Portal。
- 菜单根据可用空间翻转或收窄，长菜单在面板内滚动。用方向键移动焦点，侧向方向键打开和返回子菜单，Escape 关闭菜单并返回触发器。

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		MenuSub as SdkSub,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { MENU_SUB_POLICY_KEY, type MenuDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		loop,
		delay,
		controller,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<MenuDismissPolicy>({});
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	setContext(MENU_SUB_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: MenuDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		const isEscapeKey =
			details.reason === "escape-key" &&
			(!(details.event instanceof KeyboardEvent) || details.event.key === "Escape");
		if (!next) {
			if (
				isEscapeKey &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (isEscapeKey && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkSub
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	{controller}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkSub>

<script lang="ts">
	import { MenuTrigger as SdkTrigger, type MenuController } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		payload,
		shortcut,
		controller,
		child,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "disabled"> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		disabled?: boolean | null;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		payload?: unknown;
		shortcut?: string;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{payload}
	{shortcut}
	{controller}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "dropdown-menu-trigger",
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Menu as SdkMenu,
		type MenuActionDetails,
		type MenuCheckedChangeDetails,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuDismissReason,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
		type MenuPayloadChangeReason,
		type MenuValueChangeDetails,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails, DismissAttemptDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { MENU_POLICY_KEY, type MenuDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		modal: modalProp,
		loop,
		delay,
		presentation = "popover",
		dismissible,
		controller,
		container,
		dir: _dir,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		onPayloadChange,
		onAction,
		onCheckedChange,
		onValueChange,
		onDismissAttempt,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "pointer";
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		presentation?: "auto" | "popover" | "sheet";
		dismissible?: boolean;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		dir?: "ltr" | "rtl";
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		onPayloadChange?: (
			payload: unknown,
			details: ChangeDetails<MenuPayloadChangeReason>
		) => void;
		onAction?: (value: string, details: MenuActionDetails) => unknown;
		onCheckedChange?: (checked: boolean, details: MenuCheckedChangeDetails) => void;
		onValueChange?: (value: string, details: MenuValueChangeDetails) => void;
		onDismissAttempt?: (details: DismissAttemptDetails<MenuDismissReason>) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<MenuDismissPolicy>({});
	let policyReady = $state(typeof document === "undefined");
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	setContext(MENU_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: MenuDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	$effect(() => {
		policyReady = true;
	});

	const resolvedModal = $derived(
		modalProp ??
			(policy.trapFocus === false ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore"
				? false
				: undefined)
	);
	const resolvedOpen = $derived(open === undefined ? undefined : policyReady ? open : false);

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				(details.reason === "outside-press" ||
					details.reason === "focus-out" ||
					details.reason === "window-blur") &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkMenu
	bind:open={
		() => resolvedOpen,
		(next) => {
			if (open !== undefined) open = next;
		}
	}
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={resolvedModal}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	{presentation}
	{dismissible}
	{controller}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
	{onPayloadChange}
	{onAction}
	{onCheckedChange}
	{onValueChange}
	{onDismissAttempt}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkMenu>
